## Research question

What should this construction test?

## Assumptions and references

Separate inherited TEF assumptions from new rules. Identify paper versions where relevant.

## State and event rules

Describe local inputs, outputs, dependencies, conflict handling, and transfer accounting.

## Observables and controls

What would be measured? What comparison would distinguish the proposed mechanism from an implementation artifact?

## Failure condition

What outcome would reject or require changing this proposal?

## Reproduction plan

State initial conditions, stopping conditions, numerical requirements, and expected computational scale.
